hypothesis: The direct token-plan branch proved that whole-prompt planning plus a neural source pointer can separate Python semantics from exact requested identity. A semantic token-plan residual can preserve that factorization while replacing raw lexemes with an encoded history of public 768-wide ABI states and realizing each next unit only through a same-shape residual before the frozen tied language-model head.

materially_distinct_architecture.name: semantic_token_plan_residual
materially_distinct_architecture.source: causal history of public semantic ABI states
materially_distinct_architecture.source_encoder: two-layer Transformer encoder over the immutable prompt-state history
materially_distinct_architecture.target_controller: two-layer causal Transformer decoder over current public ABI states with cross-attention to encoded prompt states
materially_distinct_architecture.identity_path: neural source-position pointer with learned semantic value projection and neural copy gate
materially_distinct_architecture.difference_from_closed_attentive_residua: The closed branch used one undifferentiated causal stream and attempted local copy additions. This branch factorizes immutable prompt encoding from causal response planning, applies cross-attention at every response step, and trains the semantic and identity paths jointly as a token-plan controller.

losses: authoritative full-vocabulary next-unit cross-entropy through the frozen tied output head
source-position pointer cross-entropy on exact identifier units

historical_test_disclosure.policy: If the validation screen and three-seed replication pass, preregister and generate a new independently seeded adversarial final suite before accessing its rows.

decision_rule.if_initial_screen_fails: Preserve the checkpoint and evidence as negative evidence. No nearby width, loss-weight, pointer, gate, or decoding sweep is authorized without a profiler- or error-attribution-measured bottleneck.
decision_rule.if_initial_screen_passes: Run exactly the two preregistered replication seeds, then freeze the selection rule and create the fresh final protocol before final evaluation.
